trap.label: verbo + that
trap.right: She admitted that she was wrong.
trap.why: Em português “admitiu estar errada” (infinitivo). Em inglês admit é seguido de that-clause ou -ing.

opts: She said me she was tired.
She told that she was tired.
She told me she was tired.

fix.right: She decided to take a break.

fix.wrong: He said me he was late.
fix.right: He told me he was late.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I’m wrong,” she said. (She admitted that…)
rewrite.answer: She admitted that she was wrong.
She decided to take a break.

rewrite.prompt: Use told: “He said to me he was late.”
rewrite.answer: He told me he was late.
